say:1:1530106001:0.text: I was praying, offering you my devotion!
say:1:1530106001:0.source_cn: 我在向您祈祷，将我的虔诚敬献给您！
say:1:1530106001:0.male: I was praying, offering you my devotion!
say:1:1530106001:0.female: I was praying, offering you my devotion!

say:2:1530106002:1.text: Did I offend you with my stare?! Oh, mighty Herdmaster, please forgive me!
say:2:1530106002:1.source_cn: 难道是我的直视引起了您的不快？！不，伟大的神啊，请您饶恕我！
